# CangHui Material Symbols

Optional Material Symbols provider for `chui.Symbol`. Use
`cuic symbol list material` to inspect the catalog and `cuic symbol generate`
to create a declared-subset registry.

The current audited inventory contains `add`, `remove`, `close`, `check`,
`chevron-left`, and `chevron-right`. It uses the frozen outlined SVG paths;
other variants report deterministic fallback to outlined. See [UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md)
and [LICENSE](LICENSE).
